name: Zapara
source:
Pronouns: She/Her

A wolf girl who Nova met through Crowven and Theo during a celebration. She's very energetic and kind towards her friends, but originally comes off as very snappy towards Nova. They quickly gain her trust after they help her set off fireworks.

She's been a few months clean from addiction, hence why she was celebrating.
